Wide landscape composition, objects within central 80 percent for crop. No words, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, flags or portraits. One scene, no collage. An ivory gallery corridor with three open doorways side by side, each marked above with a different small abstract ceramic emblem: interlocking hands, branching paths, and a woven ring. Blue doors and small red thresholds. All three paths visible without identifying any one as morally superior. A visual invitation to distinguish different meanings of socialism.
